sources.title: Introducing Hermes 4.3: Local Intelligence Globally Trained
sources.snippet: Based on Seed-OSS-36B-Base, Hermes 4.3 is an excellent shape for consumer local inference or enterprise self-deployment. The GGUFs comfortably sit in the VRAM of off-the-shelf GPUs, offering a private, powerful, neutrally-aligned model to everyone.

sources.title: Hermes-4.3-36B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Hermes-4.3-36B is a 36-billion parameter reasoning model built on the ByteDance Seed 36B base and developed by NousResearch. It is a hybrid-mode reasoning model trained using a decentralized approach via Psyche, featuring explicit <think></think> segments for deliberation when needed.
